title: Introduce variable contrast anchors and interactive radius grid for compact widgets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Consolidate a new token subset aimed at dense/compact UI contexts: introduce variable contrast anchor tokens for interactive states, a 4-step radius grid for small controls, a compressed typography scale option, and refined micro-elevation/shadow presets for datagrid and chart overlays. This ticket covers proposals, token definitions, component token mapping, migration guidance, and rollout coordination with engineering.
context: Current token set focuses on general-purpose surface scales and medium-density components. Product teams building embedded widgets (dashboards, tables, charts) ask for higher information density with preserved accessibility. QA and engineering report inconsistent small-control radii across components and difficulty balancing contrast for compact states (hover/focus/pressed) without increasing perceived noise. This effort targets tokens that enable consistent compact variants across the component library while keeping AA contrast for primary interactions.
goals: Define a compact token subset: color anchors, radii, micro-spacing, and elevation presets
Ensure interactive contrast meets WCAG AA for text and icons in compact controls
Provide migration mapping and codemods for component teams
Ship visual spec and token spritemap + one pilot component set (Table row, Compact Button, Mini-select)
deliverables: Token spec document (Confluence) with canonical values and rationale
Figma library updates: compact color styles, radius styles, elevation overlays
Token spritemap JSON for engineers and tokens repo PR
Design QA checklist and accessibility test prompts
design_decisions: Introduce contrast anchors: neutral-compact-100..900 mapped to existing neutral ramp but rebalanced for smaller surface area and text sizing
Adopt a 4-step radius grid for compact: 2px, 4px, 6px, 8px; reserve 1px for micro-pill borders
Compressed typography scale for compact mode: cap body-sm at 12/14 for dense tables and widgets
Micro-elevation presets use subtler shadow stacks and z-offsets to avoid clipping on charts; prefer overlay tints at lowest elevations for contrast without heavy drop shadows
acceptance_criteria: Compact token spritemap merged and published to tokens repo
Three pilot components implemented and visually matched to Figma spec
Accessibility tests showing WCAG AA for primary interactive text/icons in compact variants
Component teams sign off on migration mapping and rollout plan
migration_plan: Phase 1 - Spec freeze and tokens PR (week 1): merge new compact tokens behind opt-in flag
Phase 2 - Pilot implementation (week 2): update Table row, Compact Button, Mini-select in component library
Phase 3 - Gradual rollout (weeks 3-6): component teams migrate using codemod; track regressions via visual diffs
Phase 4 - Deprecation (week 10): remove legacy compact overrides and document final mappings
rollout_steps: Publish token spritemap and create design-system PR
Coordinate with ENG on feature flag gating for private preview
QA run with visual-diff snapshots and accessibility checklist
Announce to product teams and schedule migration office hours
testing_plan: Visual diff tests for pilot components across supported themes and density modes
Keyboard and focus-ring contrast audits for compact interactive elements
Token-driven regression tests: ensure no token collisions with existing runtime overrides
Performance check: ensure no perceptible layout shift when switching density
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Compact tokens reduce perceived contrast on small text. Mitigation: enforce minimum contrast anchors and increase icon stroke where needed
Risk: Migration churn for product teams. Mitigation: provide codemod and office hours; stagger rollouts per team
Risk: Shadow/elevation changes cause layering issues on chart overlays. Mitigation: pilot with chart team to validate z-index and clipping behavior
reviewer_feedback: PM: prefer conservative contrast changes to avoid legal risk; requested AA evidence for all states - Lena Hoffman
Engineering: asked to publish tokens behind flag and include migration codemod - Samir Khan
Accessibility: recommended increasing focus ring thickness for 12px controls - Priya Menon
notes: Prototype validated on small laptop and mobile widths; micro-elevation felt lighter on chart overlays compared to current shadows
We opted to keep core color ramps identical for wide surfaces to avoid cognitive mismatch when mixing density modes
Follow-up ticket recommended to align token names with runtime feature flags (ENG-4501)
